components.name: button
components.description: Foundational generic action control with sizes XS–XL, seven variants, loading that preserves layout, and full a11y (keyboard, focus, touch ≥44px, RTL, reduced motion).

components.name: icon-button
components.description: Compact icon-only action control with required accessible name, optional desktop tooltip, sizes XS–XL, six variants, selected/loading states, and ≥44×44 touch targets.

components.name: button-group
components.description: Groups related Button and Icon Button actions with joined or spaced layouts, equal-width option, horizontal/vertical/responsive orientation, and stable loading layout.

components.name: split-button
components.description: Primary action plus an independently focusable menu of alternatives, with loading-stable layout, keyboard menu navigation, and ≥44px menu trigger.

components.name: link-button
components.description: Action control with link-like appearance (always a button, never an anchor), inline/standalone layouts, optional icons and external indicator, and accessible focus/touch targets.

components.name: floating-action-button
components.description: Prominent contextual floating action with SM/MD/LG sizes, icon/label/extended appearances, safe-area positioning, tonal elevation (no shadow), and compact collapse on narrow viewports.

components.name: toggle-button
components.description: Binary stateful action control with aria-pressed, multi-cue selected state (border, surface, indicator, optional icon/text swap), and icon/text/icon-text appearances.

components.name: segmented-control
components.description: Mutually exclusive selection among 2–5 options with integrated selected fill, radiogroup keyboard navigation, icon/label segments, and scroll or stack overflow on narrow viewports.

components.name: command-button
components.description: Workflow action with label, description, shortcut hint, status, and trailing affordance — built for command palettes and menus with keyboard-first interaction.

components.name: action-menu-trigger
components.description: Opens a contextual action menu with clear disclosure affordance, connected open state, keyboard support, mobile bottom sheet, and confirmed destructive actions.

components.name: text-input
components.description: Foundational single-line textual field with visible label, semantic types (text/email/url/tel/search/username), validation messages, clear action, counter, prefix/suffix, and sizes XS–XL.

components.name: textarea
components.description: Multi-line textual field with fixed, manual-resize, and auto-grow (min→max then scroll) modes, shared field validation chrome, and quiet character counting.

components.name: search-field
components.description: Specialized search entry with leading search icon, optional clear, reserved loading slot, host-driven instant/debounce/submit hooks, and results-status signals — without embedding suggestions or results UI.

components.name: number-input
components.description: Numeric field with integer/decimal modes, min/max/step/precision, optional steppers, prefix/suffix, and distinct empty (null) vs zero semantics — without reformatting while typing.

components.name: password-input
components.description: Masked credential field with accessible show/hide, password-manager autocomplete by purpose (new/confirm/current), and composable requirements/strength slots — no built-in strength engine.

components.name: otp-input
components.description: Short verification code field with multi-cell visuals, one logical value, paste/autofill, auto-advance, and stable error messaging — default 6 digits, lengths 4–8.

components.name: date-input
components.description: Locale-aware calendar date field with manual keyboard entry, clear, min/max/disabled dates, and a calendar trigger that composes with an external Date Picker — ISO YYYY-MM-DD values.

components.name: time-input
components.description: Locale-aware time field with 12/24-hour display, optional seconds, min/max/step, clear, keyboard adjustment, and a clock trigger that composes with an external Time Picker — values as HH:mm / HH:mm:ss.

components.name: date-time-input
components.description: Coherent date + time composition with modes (date / time / datetime), progressive seconds and timezone disclosure, shared validation shell, and responsive stacking — composes Date Input and Time Input.

components.name: input-group
components.description: Compositional primitive that joins an input with related prefixes, suffixes, icons, units, currency, or actions — attached borders, independent focus, responsive stacking. Not a generic layout component.

components.name: checkbox
components.description: Independent boolean or multi-select item with checked, unchecked, and derived indeterminate states — 20px visual at MD, ≥44×44 hit, clickable label, error/required/optional.

components.name: checkbox-group
components.description: Related independent multi-select choices with group label, description, validation, optional select-all (derived indeterminate), and vertical/horizontal/responsive layouts.

components.name: radio
components.description: Mutually exclusive choice within a radio set — 20px circular control at MD, ≥44×44 hit, clickable label, selected ring + center dot, readable disabled state.

components.name: radio-group
components.description: Mutually exclusive option set with group label, description, validation, vertical/horizontal/responsive layouts, and Tab/arrow/Space keyboard behavior.

components.name: switch
components.description: Immediate binary ON/OFF setting — 48×28 track at MD, ≥44×44 hit, label/description/status, loading lockout, logical RTL thumb travel.

components.name: select
components.description: Choose one option from a predefined list — adaptive native/listbox presentation, form-control trigger, keyboard and type-ahead, not a Combobox.

components.name: combobox
components.description: Editable text + suggestions for searchable type-ahead — filtering, async loading, free-text mode, anchored listbox; not a Select.

components.name: multi-select
components.description: Multiple selections from a predefined collection — adaptive chips/count display, search, select-all, max/min, grouped options, virtualized large lists.

components.name: choice-chips
components.description: Compact single/multi selection among a small related set — check-mark selected state, wrapping layout, ≥44×44 hits; distinct from Button/Tag/Badge/Checkbox/Radio.

components.name: slider
components.description: Numeric continuous/stepped range with single thumb — ≥44×44 hit, optional precise input, keyboard/pointer/touch; not for categorical choices.

components.name: tabs
components.description: Switch between a small set of related peer views — underline/surface/pill indicators, automatic or manual activation, scrollable overflow, semantic tab panels.

components.name: tab-bar
components.description: Persistent primary navigation for 2–5 destinations — icons, labels, badges, safe-area bottom/top placement, keyboard and screen-reader friendly.

components.name: breadcrumbs
components.description: Hierarchical location trail — linked ancestors, non-linked current page, quiet separators, intelligent overflow with discoverable hidden levels, compact mobile modes.

components.name: pagination
components.description: Navigate finite multi-page collections — previous/next/first/last, collapsing page numbers, compact mobile summary, accessible names, RTL-safe semantics.

components.name: stepper
components.description: Ordered workflow stages — completed/current/upcoming/disabled/error, horizontal/vertical/compact, linear or non-linear navigation, informational or interactive.

components.name: navigation-menu
components.description: Shell-independent hierarchical destinations — groups, nested expandable items, icons, badges, expanded/collapsed density, keyboard tree navigation.

components.name: navigation-item
components.description: Atomic navigation destination — icon, label, badge, secondary text, active/disclosure/external indicators; link or expandable semantics; usable alone or inside navigation composites.

components.name: bottom-navigation
components.description: Mobile bottom primary destinations (3–5) with icon+label, badges, safe-area, and keyboard-aware yielding so the bar does not cover focused inputs.

components.name: anchor-navigation
components.description: In-page section wayfinding with real hash links, scroll sync, sticky mode, horizontal/vertical layouts, overflow scrolling, and reduced-motion-aware smooth scroll.

components.name: previous-next-navigation
components.description: Sequential Previous/Next wayfinding with optional labels, destination titles, and icons. RTL flips placement not meaning; link semantics for document destinations; boundary disable/hide.

components.name: alert
components.description: Persistent contextual feedback — informational/success/warning/error/neutral with icon, optional title, message, actions, opt-in dismiss, compact/standard density, and appropriate live regions.

components.name: status-indicator
components.description: Compact entity/process status with host vocabulary mapped to DevKit tones (neutral/positive/warning/negative/informational); dot+text, icon+text, or text-only — not a large pill.

components.name: badge
components.description: Compact attached indicator for counts, short labels, categories, and unread marks — numeric overflow (99+), text/dot/icon-label, soft or pill radius, RTL-safe overlay anchoring.

components.name: notification
components.description: Reusable user-event item with icon/avatar, title, description, localized timestamp, unread/read distinction, separate actions, dismiss, and optional thumbnail — not a notification center.

components.name: toast
components.description: Temporary event feedback with variants, action, dismiss, configurable auto-dismiss, queued viewport placement, safe-area awareness, and subtle reduced-motion-safe animation.

components.name: progress-bar
components.description: Measurable determinate or indeterminate progress with label, optional percentage, status text, compact/standard density, semantic progressbar roles, and reduced-motion-safe animation.

components.name: progress-circle
components.description: Compact circular measurable progress (sm/md/lg) with determinate arc accuracy, restrained indeterminate motion, optional center value, and semantic progressbar roles.

components.name: spinner
components.description: Indeterminate activity indicator (xs–xl) with subtle motion, reduced-motion static fallback, accessible status text, and composition-friendly inline/block layouts — no page overlay.

components.name: skeleton
components.description: Structural content placeholders (text, title, avatar, thumbnail, rectangle) with grouped composition, calm opacity pulse, and reduced-motion static fallback — non-interactive.

components.name: empty-state
components.description: Calm content-area placeholder when there is nothing to show — distinct from loading and error; optional illustration, title, description, and DevKit action slots.

components.name: tooltip
components.description: Brief supplementary information on hover, focus, or touch long-press — non-interactive, viewport-aware placement, role=tooltip.

components.name: popover
components.description: Contextual interactive surface anchored to a trigger — configurable dismissal, optional arrow, viewport-aware placement, modal or non-modal focus.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.description: Command-oriented action menu with shortcuts, destructive items, nested submenus, checkbox/radio items, type-ahead, and mobile sheet adaptation.

components.name: context-menu
components.description: Contextual actions for an object or region — right-click, long-press, keyboard equivalent; viewport-safe positioning; not in the tree when closed.

components.name: menu
components.description: Generalized accessible command collection — semantics, keyboard, type-ahead, and item states. No positioning (parent overlay places it).

components.name: dialog
components.description: Modal surface for focused interaction — header/content/footer, focus trap, configurable dismiss, responsive sizes, scrollable body with sticky actions.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.description: High-priority alertdialog for destructive or critical decisions — deliberate action required, safe-action focus, never dismissed by outside click.

components.name: drawer
components.description: Temporary side-entering surface for navigation, filters, and supporting content — modal/non-modal, RTL-aware sides, mobile sheet transformation, swipe dismiss.

components.name: bottom-sheet
components.description: Touch-oriented temporary surface from the bottom — compact to full height, drag/Escape/outside dismiss, modal/non-modal/persistent, desktop dialog fallback.

components.name: modal-surface
components.description: Generic elevated temporary surface — backdrop, focus, positioning, dismissal, and responsive sizing without forced chrome. Foundation for Dialog and Alert Dialog.

components.name: card
components.description: Flexible surface for grouping related content — composable header/body/footer/media, quiet default elevation, interactive and selected states.

components.name: list
components.description: Container for ordered or unordered collections — density, optional dividers, grouping, single/multiple/none selection, keyboard navigation. Empty via Empty State.

components.name: list-item
components.description: Atomic list content row — leading, primary, secondary, trailing regions; single/two/multi-line; density; clear interactive vs trailing-action models.

components.name: data-row
components.description: Structured label/value fields for detail views and records — responsive stack/columns, leading/status/actions, optional dividers. Not a table row.

components.name: avatar
components.description: Identity mark for person/organization/entity — image, initials, icon fallback, presence/status. Sizes map to control-height tokens.

components.name: avatar-group
components.description: Compact multi-identity arrangement — modest overlap or separated, max visible, +N overflow with touch-friendly details. Only max avatars mount.

components.name: key-value-pair
components.description: Structured label + value metadata — secondary label, dominant value, horizontal/vertical/responsive, long-value overflow. Compose actions with Interaction Controls.

components.name: divider
components.description: Subtle structural separator — horizontal/vertical, full/inset/section/content-aligned. Vertical stretches with content. Optional semantic separator role.

components.name: timeline
components.description: Chronological event sequence — vertical default, optional horizontal for short content, markers/connectors, status cues beyond connector color. Events not clickable by default.

components.name: content-block
components.description: Neutral structural grouping — heading, description, content, metadata, actions, optional divider. No card chrome. Lighter than Card.

components.name: image
components.description: Fundamental visual-content primitive — alt/decorative, aspect ratio, object-fit, responsive sources, lazy/eager/priority, loading and non-breaking error fallback.

components.name: thumbnail
components.description: Compact visual preview — square/portrait/landscape, cover/contain by kind, selected/loading/error, sparse overlays (play, type, duration). Sizes use global tokens.

components.name: media-object
components.description: Media with adjacent text — leading/trailing media, title/description/metadata/status/actions, predictable media box, auto-stack on narrow, split interactivity when trailing controls exist.

components.name: icon-container
components.description: Controlled icon region — optically centered glyph, square/circle/rounded/transparent shapes, sm/md/lg via tokens, semantic tones, decorative by default.

components.name: illustration
components.description: Presentation container for conceptual visuals — sm/md/lg/hero, contain/natural fit, alignment, decorative or labeled, no default animation (reduced-motion safe).

components.name: cover-media
components.description: Rectangular cover region with controlled cropping — cover/contain, focal points, compact/standard/wide/hero ratios, optional overlay/caption with solid contrast scrim.

components.name: media-preview
components.description: Larger media preview — image/video poster/document/audio/generic, loading states, optional title/meta, actions via DevKit controls. Not a lightbox or full player.

components.name: image-placeholder
components.description: Neutral media-region placeholder for loading/missing/unavailable/error — aspect-locked, optional icon/type/short message. Not Skeleton.

components.name: media-overlay
components.description: Controlled content over media — top/bottom/corner/full, solid contrast scrim, play/status/duration/selection/title/actions. Hover enhances only.

components.name: media-metadata
components.description: Secondary media details — type/dimensions/duration/size/date/author/status, compact/standard, wrap-friendly, localizable format helpers. Composable with media primitives.

components.name: text
components.description: Fundamental typography primitive — tokenized size/weight/color, semantic `as` independent of style, wrap by default, opt-in truncate/clamp/transform.

components.name: heading
components.description: Semantic h1–h6 with visual size independent of level — subtitle, alignment, wrap-by-default, opt-in truncate, responsive typography tokens.

components.name: paragraph
components.description: Readable body content — standard/lead/secondary via tokens, comfortable line-height, reading measure, modest consecutive rhythm, accessible inline links.

components.name: label
components.description: Concise control/content identification — htmlFor association, required/optional not color-only, wraps long labels, readable token sizes. Not Caption.

components.name: caption
components.description: Secondary explanatory text — short/multiline, readable caption tokens, figcaption or aria-describedby association. Not Label; not for primary instructions or sole warnings.

components.name: link
components.description: Navigation anchor — inline/standalone, underline not color-only, opt-in external mark, visited/focus/hover, wraps long URLs. Not a Button.

components.name: code
components.description: Short inline monospace content — commands, identifiers, keyboard shortcuts. Compact; wrap or scroll for long tokens. No syntax highlighting.

components.name: code-block
components.description: Multiline source / preformatted content — language label, optional line numbers, copy via Icon Button, scroll/wrap, highlighted lines, collapse, loading/empty/error. Bounded height; LTR code in RTL UI. Syntax tokens not color-only.

components.name: blockquote
components.description: Quoted content with optional author, source, and navigable source link. Distinguished via spacing, border, typography, and indentation — not oversized marks or testimonial chrome. RTL-aware; quote dir auto/ltr/rtl.

components.name: number-display
components.description: Locale-aware numeric display — integer, decimal, currency, percent, signed, unit, opt-in compact. Loading/unknown/N/A without layout shift. Tabular alignment; negative not color-only. Full value for screen readers. Not a metric card.

components.name: action-button-group
components.description: Clusters related Button actions with joined/separated layout, compact/standard density, horizontal/vertical orientation, and wrap/stack overflow. Each button stays independently focusable and disableable. Prefer Action Group for large sets.

components.name: icon-button-group
components.description: Clusters related Icon Button actions — horizontal/vertical, joined/separated, wrap/stack. Selected/disabled/active via Icon Button. Accessible labels required. Prefer Overflow Action for large sets.

components.name: action-split-button
components.description: Primary action + menu trigger composition. Uses Button styles; menu via Dropdown Menu + ActionSplitMenuTrigger — menu not implemented inside. Independent primary/menu disabled states; touch-safe trigger.

components.name: action-segmented-control
components.description: Small mutually exclusive choice set (2–5). Single selection with fill+border+weight selected state. Overflow wrap/stack/scroll (scroll opt-in; no auto-dropdown). RTL-aware keyboard. Optional semantic icons.

components.name: action-group
components.description: Flexible semantic action cluster with mixed treatments — primary/secondary/icon/menu/destructive via composed primitives. Responsive wrap/stack; hidden items leave no gaps; overflow slot for Overflow Action handoff.
